test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.

__Neither of the two companies are winning__ in the price war.

options.text: Neither of two company is winning
Neither of the companies are winning
Neither of the two companies is winning

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the sentence, the subject is **"Neither of the two companies".**
 
• The word **"neither"** is** used to** mean "not one and not the other of two", so it's** singular.**
 
• Therefore, the **verb should** also be in the **singular** form to agree with the subject.
 
• Thus,** "is winning"** is the **correct verb **form to use, not "are winning".

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: ***Neither of the two companies is **winning in the price war.*
